data.name: Fatheha
data.long_meaning: Fatheha is an Arabic name derived from the root letters 'FaTha' and 'Haa'. It means 'giver of goodness' or 'opener of the heart to the truth'. In Islamic teachings, Fatimah bint Muhammad, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad, is often referred to as 'Umm Al-Fadl' (Mother of Goodness) due to her exceptional virtues and piety.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of compassion and benevolence, Fatheha represents the spirit of generosity and kindness towards others.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Fatheha are creative, artistic, and expressive individuals. They have a strong emotional side and are natural caretakers, often putting others' needs before their own.
